description: This file contains the implementation of WebSocket server upgrade logic, including the Upgrader struct, error handling, and connection upgrade procedures for the Gorilla WebSocket library.

classes.name: HandshakeError
classes.description: Represents an error during WebSocket handshake.

classes.name: Upgrader
classes.description: Configures parameters for upgrading an HTTP connection to a WebSocket connection.

classes.name: brNetConn
classes.description: A wrapper around net.Conn with buffered reading capabilities.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for HandshakeError.

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Handles error responses during WebSocket upgrade.

methods.name: selectSubprotocol
methods.description: Selects the subprotocol to use based on client request and server preferences.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Performs the WebSocket upgrade process, including handshake and connection setup.

methods.name: Subprotocols
methods.description: Parses and returns the list of subprotocols requested by the client.

methods.name: IsWebSocketUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP request is a WebSocket upgrade request.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from brNetConn, limiting to buffered data if available.

methods.name: NetConn
methods.description: Returns the underlying net.Conn from brNetConn.
